tips.frostedheart.scenario_tip.title: Tips
tips.frostedheart.scenario_tip.desc3: Press&6 [ESC]&r five times to skip cinematic
tips.frostedheart.sensible_temperature.d: The orb at the bottom of your screen displays your&6 Apparent Temperature&r, which reflects whether you feel&b&l cold&r or&6&l hot&r in the current environment.

Please note that&6 Apparent Temperature&l is NOT&r&6 Body Temperature&r, but rather a calculation result combining factors like ambient temperature, body heat, and clothing. The most comfortable perceived temperature is around&6 30°C&r (&686°F&r).
tips.frostedheart.murderer.title: Murderer
tips.frostedheart.murderer.desc1: You killed a non-hostile human being. Clearly, this won't do any good to your relationship with them.
tips.frostedheart.murderer.desc3: If you continue doing this, they might refuse to trade or communicate with you.
tips.frostedheart.maniac.title: Maniac
tips.frostedheart.maniac.desc1: Your&c deeds&r have spread among them...
tips.frostedheart.plant.title: Planting
tips.frostedheart.plant.desc1: Simply scattering seeds on snow and expecting growth is clearly unrealistic. Crops now require&b suitable environmental conditions&r to grow.
tips.frostedheart.plant.desc2: Hold&6 [S]&r while hovering seed in the inventory to view its planting information.
tips.frostedheart.soil_temperature.title: Soil Temperature
tips.frostedheart.soil_temperature.desc1: Crops require suitable soil temperatures to grow. When soil temperature exceeds the survival range, crops will begin to wither, while suitable temperatures accelerate growth.
tips.frostedheart.soil_temperature.desc2: Soil temperature is influenced by natural factors such as&b weather&r,&b altitude&r, and&b biome&r.
tips.frostedheart.soil_temperature.desc3: Heat sources like campfires and torches do not affect soil temperature; only&6 more advanced heating equipment&r can heat the soil.
tips.frostedheart.soil_temperature.desc4: Soil temperature is not directly displayed. You must research and unlock the {item.frostedheart.soil_thermometer} to measure it.
tips.frostedheart.shelter_and_light.desc: Most crops require&b Sunlight (Sky Light)&r to grow properly. However, during severe weather like blizzards, exposed crops may be destroyed. You may need to build shelters using&b transparent blocks&r like glass to protect them.
tips.frostedheart.fertilizer.title: Fertilizer
tips.frostedheart.fertilizer.desc1: Fertilizers provide various growth benefits to crops. Hold&6 [Shift]&r while hovering fertilizer in the inventory to view specific effects.
tips.frostedheart.fertilizer.desc2: There are three types of fertilizer: Growth Acceleration, Yield Booster, and Preserved, each with three tiers: Basic, Advanced, and Modern. Higher-tier fertilizers offer stronger effects.
tips.frostedheart.fertilizer.desc3: Hold fertilizer and right-click on soil or crops to apply it. Each soil block can hold up to 2 units of the same fertilizer, which are gradually consumed as crops grow.
tips.frostedheart.soil_thermometer.desc1: Hold the {item.frostedheart.soil_thermometer} to view real-time information such as planting temperature and remaining fertilizer levels on the screen.
tips.frostedheart.infrared_view.title: Infrared Vision
tips.frostedheart.infrared_view.desc1: Your glasses are equipped with infrared vision. Press&6 [I]&r to view temperature area variations.
tips.frostedheart.ponder.title: Ponder
tips.frostedheart.ponder.desc1: Pondering helps you intuitively understand an item or block's functionality. When an item has a ponder prompt, hold&6 [W]&r to enter the pondering scene.
tips.frostedheart.wheel_menu.title: Radial Menu
tips.frostedheart.wheel_menu.desc1: Hold&6 [Tab]&r to open the radial menu and access various quick functions. Select&b [{gui.frostedheart.wheel_menu.selection.archive}]&r to view all obtained tips.
tips.frostedheart.wheel_menu.desc2: Not enough keys? Select&b [{gui.wheel_menu.editor.edit}]&r to add custom options, including Key Binds and Commands, and hide or rearrange selections.
tips.frostedheart.wheel_menu.desc3: You can also change the default key bind in [&bOptions&r →&b Controls&r →&b Keybinds&r →&b Frosted Heart&r]
tips.frostedheart.campfire.title: Campfire
tips.frostedheart.campfire.desc1: A burning campfire can provide warmth and can be used for &6cooking food&r and &6boiling water&r.
tips.frostedheart.campfire.desc2: The campfire requires the addition of fuel. Press&6 [Q]&r to drop combustible items into the campfire, then ignite it using any igniter.
tips.frostedheart.campfire.desc3: Lighting a campfire in an open environment is not very effective. Surround the campfire with blocks to create a structure similar to a&6 fireplace&r, which can concentrate the heat emitted by the campfire.
tips.frostedheart.campfire.desc4: Don't get too close, as the high temperature may burn you!
tips.frostedheart.vawt.title: VAWT
tips.frostedheart.vawt.desc1: The Vertical Axis Wind Turbine, a structurally simple wind generator that converts &bWind Energy&r into &6Stress&r, freeing you from manual cranking.
tips.frostedheart.vawt.desc2: The wind turbine must be placed in &bopen terrain&r and &bcannot have other wind turbines nearby&r, or it will cease to function.
tips.frostedheart.vawt.desc3: Over time, the wind turbine will wear out and eventually break down completely. You can then recycle it to recover some of the materials.
tips.frostedheart.vawt.desc4: During blizzards, it generates more Stress, but the turbine will also degrade at an accelerated rate.
tips.frostedheart.clay_pot.title: Clay Pot
tips.frostedheart.clay_pot.desc1: The clay pot can be used to smelt ores or fired into a container for storing items.
tips.frostedheart.clay_pot_smelt.title: Smelting Ores
tips.frostedheart.clay_pot_smelt.desc1:
Hold the clay pot and right-click to put raw ore and fuel. After firing it, right-click on the ground to break it open and obtain the finished product.
You can view available recipes in JEI.
tips.frostedheart.clay_pot_ceramic.title: Ceramic Pot
tips.frostedheart.clay_pot_ceramic.desc1:
If no items are placed inside, it can be fired into a &6Ceramic Pot&r.
When placed, the ceramic pot acts as a small container, and it will &6retain its contents&r when you destroy it.
tips.frostedheart.gunpowder_barrel.title: Gunpowder Barrel
tips.frostedheart.gunpowder_barrel.desc1: The gunpowder barrel can destroy a large range of blocks. Place it on the ground and &6ignite&r it, or hold right-click to &6throw&r it.
tips.frostedheart.gunpowder_barrel.desc2: The materials used to craft the gunpowder barrel determine its range and fortune level. The maximum range is &67*7*7&r blocks, and the maximum fortune level is &6IV&r.
tips.frostedheart.gunpowder_barrel.desc3: The gunpowder barrel can be crafted again to enhance the fortune effect, but this will not increase its range.
tips.frostedheart.gunpowder_barrel.desc4: Crafting the gunpowder barrel with sand will cause it to fall after ignition; crafting it with water will make its explosion not destroy blocks.
